theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lpo_affine_homotopy
theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' : ℕ) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N'), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → ∃ H : Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N', ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) H ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = F x + t • (G x - F x)) ∧ ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N') (H : Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N') (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → DifferentiableAt ℝ G x → DifferentiableAt ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (z : Euclid N), H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp z))) = F z + s • (G z - F z)) → fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) = G x - F x ∧ (∀ v : Euclid N, fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v))) = fderiv ℝ F x v + t • (fderiv ℝ G x v - fderiv ℝ F x v)) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)))‖ ≤ ‖G x - F x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ F x + t • (fderiv ℝ G x - fderiv ℝ F x)‖
